name: Admin Documentation
author: Basecraft

sections.description:
Add a simple documentation page to your WordPress admin to keep instructions, notes, and other helpful information for maintaining your website.

Features

  • Create documentation using the WordPress content editor that you’re already familiar with.
  • Add text, images, videos, and other media to your documentation.
  • Organize your documentation into sections that automatically populate into a clickable table of contents.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Improved – Embedded video support

1.1.0

  • Improved – Automatic responsive scaling for all images
